---
name: TV Device Compatibility Report
about: Report a tested Android TV or Google TV model (working or issues)
title: '[COMPAT] '
labels: compatibility
assignees: ''
---

**Device Information**
- **Brand / Manufacturer**: [e.g. Xiaomi, Sony, TCL, Philips, Google, OnePlus]
- **Model Name / Number**: [e.g. MiTV 4X, Sony Bravia X90J, Chromecast with Google TV 4K]
- **OS Version**: [e.g. Android TV 9, Android TV 11, Google TV 12]

**Connection & Features Tested**
- [ ] Auto-discovery via mDNS (`_androidtvremote2._tcp`)
- [ ] Manual IP pairing with PIN code
- [ ] D-Pad navigation (Up, Down, Left, Right, Select)
- [ ] Volume & Channel rockers (with long-press repeating)
- [ ] Media playback controls (Play, Pause, Fast-forward, Rewind)
- [ ] App shortcut launchers (YouTube, Netflix, etc.)
- [ ] Wake-on-LAN (Powering TV on from sleep)

**Notes / Observations**
Any quirks or specific settings required on the TV (e.g., enabling "Network Standby" or "Remote Control").
